note: Fictional manual review examples. Expectations use the included federal and EU texts; national implementation and state law still need separate checks. These files are not automated model tests.

lawFindings.issue: Waives overtime for a covered non-exempt employee working more than 40 hours.

Prohibits protected employee discussion of wages and working conditions.
Requires retirement because of age without an applicable exception.

lawfulClauses.why: Direct deposit is optional and a paper check is available.
Customer credentials remain confidential without restricting employee discussion of employment conditions.

notCovered.why: The pack cannot determine the effect of an at-will term under Colorado law.

lawfulClauses.why: Repair or replacement can be chosen subject to impossibility and disproportionate cost.
